answer: Farming becomes a wharf bet on surviving 80 epochs of grading, and every opal settlement recomputes the ember schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 80 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
